{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |year=2018–19 |team=Mississippi State Bulldogs |sport=Basketball |image=Mississippi State Bulldogs logo.svg |image_size=150 |conference=Southeastern Conference |short_conf=SEC |CoachRank= |APRank = |record= 23–11 |conf_record= 10–8 |head_coach= [[Ben Howland]] |hc_year=4th |asst_coach1= George Brooks |asst_coach2= Korey McCray |asst_coach3= [[Ernie Zeigler]] |stadium= [[Humphrey Coliseum]] |champion= |tourney= [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = First Round }} {{2018–19 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Mississippi State Bulldogs basketball team''' represented [[Mississippi State University]] in the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bulldogs, led by fourth-year head coach [[Ben Howland]], played their home games at the [[Humphrey Coliseum]] in [[Starkville, Mississippi]] as members of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 23-11, to finish a tie for 6th place. In the SEC Tournament, They defeated [[2018–19 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]] in the second round before losing to [[2018–19 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]] in the quarterfinals. They received a at-large bid to the NCAA Tournament where they were upset by 12th seed [[2018–19 Liberty Flames basketball team|Liberty]] in the first round. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 25–12, 9–9 in SEC play to finish in a tie for seventh place. They defeated [[2017–18 LSU Tigers basketball team|LSU]] in the second round of the [[2018 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2017–18 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]]. They were received an at-large bid to the [[2018 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2017-18 Nebraska Cornhuskers men's basketball team|Nebraska]], [[2017-18 Baylor Bears men's basketball team|Baylor]], and [[2017-18 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|Louisville]] to advance to the semifinals where they lost to [[2017–18 Penn State Nittany Lions men's basketball team|Penn State]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
